source_review: Both work classes get visits despite continual source updates or repeated failed fits.
Fit readiness still checks source price/news clocks and fresh quote; no fabricated observation time on failed shared capture.
Separate v2 config/runtime/schema and required 16-source registry binding retain all existing frozen model/input/ledger/evaluator files.

independent_probe.scope: Isolated scheduler only: no runner constructor, executor, ledger files or live clock; not a live throughput or uptime test.

owner_test_scope: Owner reports 68-pair continuous-update regression and 408 alternating tasks with three fits and three captures per pair; 60 pytest cases total, not 408 tests.
limitations: The v1 collector eventually published; the initial delay is preserved rather than described as permanent zero output.
Actual runtime preflight, activation and dashboard reload are separately verified by root.
